stages.purpose: Qualify three native providers with exact historical Lake bindings, then compile/audit the eight Buchstab project owners.
stages.command:
python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('\''verification/part2/supervise_p21_resume.py'\'');assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='\''4d38c8046cdc43d01b5d00d67d3c5bcd34244d581ab6fa6bde545724a7fb8ff7'\''
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent.resolve()));import supervise_p21_resume as s
head=s.update(require_sparse=True);assert head
groups,roots,_,_=s.selection()
helper=Path('\''verification/part2/extend_p21_buchstab_native_snapshot.py'\'');assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='\''af9b5397ae5ade235a2875354d7d0f24f811719bb2c7201a84128c3fbac82bd6'\''
print('\''P21_CASING_QUALIFICATION_HEAD'\'',head,flush=True)
argv=[sys.executable,str(helper),'\''--snapshot'\'',str(s.BASE),'\''--snapshot-sha256'\'',s.BASE_SHA]
print('\''P21_CASING_QUALIFICATION_COMMAND'\'',json.dumps(argv),flush=True)
r=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print(r.stdout,flush=True);print('\''P21_CASING_QUALIFICATION_EXIT'\'',r.returncode,flush=True)
if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
result=json.loads(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]);assert result['\''modules'\'']==518 and result['\''compile_credit'\''] is False and result['\''kernel_credit'\''] is False
snapshot=Path(result['\''snapshot'\'']);assert hashlib.sha256(snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==result['\''sha256'\''] and s.snapshots()==[s.BASE,snapshot]
destination=Path('\''.lake/p2-private/p21-buchstab-extension-result.json'\'');assert not destination.is_symlink()
if destination.exists():assert json.loads(destination.read_bytes())==result
else:
 with destination.open('\''x'\'') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\''\n'\'')
print('\''P21_CASING_EXTENSION_VERIFIED'\'',json.dumps(result),flush=True)
names=groups[1];assert len(names)==8
codes=[]
for argv in [[sys.executable,str(s.NORMAL),s.BUCHSTAB,'\''--workers'\'','\''1'\'','\''--threads'\'','\''1'\'','\''--memory-mb'\'','\''11264'\'','\''--time-budget-seconds'\'','\''900'\'','\''--external-snapshot'\'',str(snapshot)],[sys.executable,str(s.AUDIT),*names,'\''--memory-mb'\'','\''11264'\'','\''--summary-name'\'','\''p21-casing-buchstab-owners.json'\'','\''--external-snapshot'\'',str(snapshot)]]:
 print('\''P21_CASING_BUCHSTAB_PHASE'\'',json.dumps(argv),flush=True);r=subprocess.run(argv);codes.append(r.returncode);print('\''P21_CASING_BUCHSTAB_PHASE_EXIT'\'',r.returncode,flush=True)
print('\''P21_CASING_BUCHSTAB_CODES'\'',json.dumps(codes),flush=True);raise SystemExit(int(any(codes)))
'

stages.purpose: Continue all 140 strict owners; if native qualification remains unavailable, complete only the 80 required block-owner audits.
stages.command:
python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('\''verification/part2/supervise_p21_resume.py'\'');assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='\''4d38c8046cdc43d01b5d00d67d3c5bcd34244d581ab6fa6bde545724a7fb8ff7'\''
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent.resolve()));import supervise_p21_resume as s
head=s.update(require_sparse=True);assert head
groups,_,_,_=s.selection();snaps=s.snapshots()
print('\''P21_CONTINUATION_HEAD'\'',head,flush=True)
if all(snaps):
 raise SystemExit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p),'\''--budget-seconds'\'','\''3300'\'']).returncode)
names=[n for n in groups[0] if re.fullmatch(r'\''ImbalancedChen\.Certificates\.OriginalNodeArraysV1\.Block\d\d(?:Data|FullCheck)'\'',n)]
assert set(names)=={'\''ImbalancedChen.Certificates.OriginalNodeArraysV1.Block'\''+str(i).zfill(2)+kind for i in range(40) for kind in ['\''Data'\'','\''FullCheck'\'']}
argv=[sys.executable,str(s.AUDIT),*names,'\''--memory-mb'\'','\''11264'\'','\''--summary-name'\'','\''p21-current-template-block-owners.json'\'','\''--external-snapshot'\'',str(s.BASE)]
print('\''P21_NATIVE_PENDING_CONTINUE_EXISTING_BLOCK_OWNERS'\'',json.dumps(argv),flush=True)
r=subprocess.run(argv)
print('\''P21_BLOCK_OWNER_EXIT_NATIVE_STILL_REQUIRED'\'',r.returncode,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(r.returncode or 2)
'

stages.purpose: Run the original exporter, joint-import validation and archive verification only after all 140 accepted receipts are present.
stages.command:
python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('\''verification/part2/supervise_p21_resume.py'\'');assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='\''4d38c8046cdc43d01b5d00d67d3c5bcd34244d581ab6fa6bde545724a7fb8ff7'\''
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent.resolve()));import supervise_p21_resume as s
head=s.update(require_sparse=True);assert head
groups,_,_,_=s.selection();names=[n for group in groups for n in group]
waiting=[]
for n in names:
 f=s.AUDITS/n/'\''latest.json'\''
 if not f.is_file() or json.loads(f.read_bytes()).get('\''accepted'\'') is not True:waiting.append(n)
if waiting or not all(s.snapshots()):
 print('\''P21_FINALIZATION_NOT_STARTED'\'',json.dumps({'\''head'\'':head,'\''missing_accepted_receipts'\'':waiting,'\''proof_credit'\'':False}),flush=True);raise SystemExit(2)
print('\''P21_FINALIZATION_GUARDED_HEAD'\'',head,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'\''verification/part2/finalize_p21.py'\'']).returncode)
'
